attempts.byline: by Max H. Bazerman (Author), Don A. Moore (Author) Format: Hardcover
attempts.pageTitle: Judgment in Managerial Decision Making - Bazerman, Max H., Moore, Don A. | 9781118065709 | Amazon.com.au | Books
attempts.description: id="bookDescription_feature_div" class="celwidget" data-feature-name="bookDescription" data-csa-c-type="widget" data-csa-c-content-id="bookDescription" data-csa-c-slot-id="bookDescription_feature_div" data-csa-c-asin="1118065700" data-csa-c-is-in-initial-active-row="false"> Behavioral decision research provides many important insights into managerial behavior. From negotiation to investment decisions, the authors weave behavioral decision research into the organizational realm by examining judgment in a variety of managerial contexts. Embedded with the latest research and theories, Managerial Decision Making 8th Edition gives students the opportunity to understand their own decision-making tendencies, learn strategies for overcoming cognitive biases, and become better decision makers.
